verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a documented Public APIv2 with an OpenAPI-based reference covering CRUD across most domains: controls, policies, evidence library, frameworks, monitoring tests, personnel, devices, risks, audits and custom connections. OAuth setup is also documented, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Probes found no raw OpenAPI spec at standard paths, and some endpoints are marked experimental (🧪). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec file.
